scope: exposed development holdout; proxy consistency only
primary_unit: one trial at fixed window_end=40 seconds, published at 42 seconds
secondary_unit: all three windows, descriptive; overlapping windows are not independent trials
methods: existing experiment.methods C0/C1/C2/C3, unchanged native quality gates
quality: same observations and clock; method-specific refusal retained, no common-decided filtering
truth: versioned candidate proxy; UNKNOWN kept separate; episode labels shown as counterexamples only
recall: TP / all label-positive trials including refused positives
false_positive_rate: FP / all label-negative trials including refused negatives
delay: null: no independent event onset in proxy annotations
selection: no tuning or refitting; locked P2 model only
comparison: paired counts on same trial set; no real-world efficacy or ML benefit inference
